notes.title: Rollback Network Patch v1.05
notes.notes:
We have implemented a patch that addresses some other issues.
The patch note details can be found below:

- Bugfix: anti-aliasing setting was not applied when using 'Windowed Borderless' display mode.
- Bugfix: could not access the button settings menu when playing with keyboard only.
- Bugfix: possible case of backward-typing in chat boxes caused by bad controllers or bloated systems.
- Bugfix: 'Key to the Future is in the Past' achievement could not be unlocked if the player had already spectated 20 or more battles. It should unlock correctly after the next spectate session.
- Bugfix: two very sporadic crash occurrences.

notes.title: Rollback Network Patch v1.04
notes.notes:
We have implemented a patch that addresses some network issues.
The patch note details can be found below:

- Added options support for "Windowed", "Windowed Borderless" and "Fullscreen" display modes
- Controller hot-swap support added to plug and unplug both XInput and DirectInput controllers at any time
- 4 controllers support added
- Steam deck: text dialogs for passwords and chat automatically open up Steam's on-screen text input dialog window and keyboard
- Fixed the FPS counter showing misleading numbers

notes.title: Rollback Network Patch v1.03
notes.notes:
We will be implementing a patch that addresses some network issues.
The patch will go live on March 27th 12AM PDT.
Thank you for your patience while we worked to solve these issues.
The patch note details can be found below:


- Fixed spectators desynchronization issues
- Fixed a crash that occurred when re-matching after a match lasted longer than 4 minutes
- Fixed a crash that occurred when the game is launched without Steam running (a message is now displayed)
- Fixed the Steam invite system to prevent friends from attempting to join Ranked or Big lobby matches via Steam invitations. Steam invitations should only work for Player Rooms, and not anywhere else.

notes.title: Rollback Network Patch v1.02
notes.notes:
We will be implementing a patch that addresses the recent network issues.
The patch will go live on February 17th 12AM PST.
Thank you for your patience while we worked to solve this problem.
Please see the patch notes below for details:

Guilty Gear Xrd REV2 Rollback v1.02
Update contents
Network
- Fix applied to avoid desync during sudden massive lag spikes or under heavy network conditions
- Fix applied to prevent crashes during the start or end of matches
- Fix applied to reduce rare stutters during gameplay 

Visuals
- Blinking of stage specific lightings on characters during high rollbacks corrected
- Blinking of BurstHeal and Raven's blood particles during high rollbacks corrected
- Blinking of Ranked mode Treasure, 'GET!', and Medals during high rollbacks corrected

Other
- Incorrect message "save data corrupted" while having more than two controllers plugged on game launch fixed
- R-Code will not appear anymore when typing the letter J while entering Player Room passwords
- Quickly shuffling the cups during Faust's "Stimulating Fists of Annihilation" should not cause crashes anymore
- Facilitated detection of dedicated GPU usage preference for Windows

notes.title: GUILTY GEAR XRD REV 2 ROLLBACK NETCODE PUBLIC TEST BEGINS OCT. 17
notes.notes:
We are pleased to announce our launch for the public testing phase for rollback netcode implementation for GUILTY GEAR Xrd REV 2, starting [b]Oct 17th 0000h PDT![/b]
With this implementation, our final goal is to allow seamless online gameplay with players over the world.
*Individual players' network infrastructure conditions may still apply. 

This public test is for us to better identify potential bugs and issues with the rollback netcode implementation, and the overall game play may still be unstable. Please report any bugs found over at the Community Hub, where we have set up a specific sub-forum for the public test.
https://steamcommunity.com/app/520440/discussions/7/

[h1]HOW TO ACCESS[/h1]
Please follow the following instructions to access the public test:
1) From the Steam client, select the game, right click, and select "Properties".
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27020717/09e641c1af5880bff3a1b70e9e9a38485cb0c783.png[/img]

2) Select the "BETAS" tab.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27020717/708377c898e777f7ed5f2b6e54a800a02d838dc7.png[/img]

3) From the "Select the beta you would like to opt into" drag down menu, select "publictest".
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27020717/78640ee1be5533398c49e731ae55a46d9dde6142.png[/img]

4) Close the properties menu.

5) The game will automatically update. After the update has ended, you're set to go!

notes.title: Brand new Guilty Gear set for 2020
notes.notes:
Arc System Works announced a brand new Guilty Gear game at the Evo 2019 tournament over the weekend.

The 2.5D fighting game is due out at some point in 2020, although we don't know for which platforms.

The brief teaser, below shows a gorgeous art style, fluid action and trademark rock soundtrack. There are what looks like stage transitions in there as well as a mysterious brand new character. It looks to me like Arc System Works has taken the brilliant work it did for Dragon Ball FighterZ and applied it to Guilty Gear for its visuals.

notes.title: v2.03 "After Story C" and Updates (August 9th)
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27020717/e69d78a2c4bfe2def1e96a9b16f8d0df6b2fc6b9.jpg[/img]
The much anticipated "After Story C" is now out on Steam! Users can watch the new Story chapter "After Story C" after applying this patch.
Also, we have included several other performance fixes for better overall gameplay experience.

The main features of this patch are as follows:
●【Story】
Added "After Story C".
[i]*Users will need to clear the main Story mode to be able to play "After Story C".[/i]
[i]*Users will need to purchase the "GUILTY GEAR Xrd REV 2 Upgrade" DLC to access the After Stories. [/i]

●【Digital Figures】
New items will be acquired after clearing "After Story C".


[b]The main changes and issues fixed are as follows:[/b]
●【ZATO=1】Fixed an issue where the "Shadow Puddle" set by "Eddie's Shadow Dive" becomes invulnerable.
●【I-NO】Fixed an issue where I-no will be able to do a regular air dash instead of a downward air dash after a ground front dash with ↘-input.
●【RAMLETHAL】Reduced the amount of time available to follow up after landing a regular throw on Baiken.
●【LEO WHITEFANG】①Fixed an issue where "Kahn Schild" continues to reflect projectile even after the action has been altered. ②Fixed an issue where Leo swap places with grounded opponent while he is in the crumpled state. 
●【JOHNNY】Fixed an issue where the opponent will be grounded after being air-thrown at a low height.
●【KUM HAEHYUN】Haehyun will not be able to do "Four Tiger Swords (Reverse)" after "Four Tiger Swords (Hold)" once Haehyun has left the ground.
Haehyun will still be able to cancel into "Four Tiger Swords (Reverse)" on the ground regardless on hit or whiff.
●【RAVEN】①Fixed an issue where Raven would not lose excitement gauge after a whiffed "Wachen Zweig (S Ver)". ②Fixed an issue where the slow effect from "Schmerz Berg" and "Grebechlich Licht" continues to persist after its intended duration.
●【ANSWER】Fixed an issue during "Savvy Ninpo: Seal of Approval", where Answer will cling to the wrong position.

notes.title: v1.01 Update (January 24th)
notes.notes:
The following issues have been addressed in this update:
- Fixed issue where users can enter password-protected player rooms without entering the password.
- Fixed issue where the textbox instantly disappears when trying to call it up with a specific Button Configuration setting.
- D-input buttons are now rightfully assigned as equivalent to their X-input counterpart buttons.
*Due to this modification, users may experience their button configurations to be mixed up after the patch. We would like to urge users to kindly review their button configurations once again after applying the patch. We apologize for the inconvenience caused.

The following new features have been added to the game:
- Mouse cursors will be hidden now when left idle on the screen.
- RS/LS (aka R3/L3) buttons can now be assigned in Button Configuration.
- Game sound will continue to play even when the user shifts the focus away to other screens.
[b]- Chinese (Simplified & Traditional) and Korean language text support has been added![/b]

notes.title: v1.01 Update (January 24th)
notes.notes:
The following issues have been addressed in this update:
- Fixed issue where users can enter password-protected player rooms without entering the password.
- Fixed issue where the textbox instantly disappears when trying to call it up with a specific Button Configuration setting.
- D-input buttons are now rightfully assigned as equivalent to their X-input counterpart buttons.
*Due to this modification, users may experience their button configurations to be mixed up after the patch. We would like to urge users to kindly review their button configurations once again after applying the patch. We apologize for the inconvenience caused.

The following new features have been added to the game:
- Mouse cursors will be hidden now when left idle on the screen.
- RS/LS (aka R3/L3) buttons can now be assigned in Button Configuration.
- Game sound will continue to play even when the user shifts the focus away to other screens.
[b]- Chinese (Simplified & Traditional) and Korean language text support has been added![/b]
